description: Fix data integrity issues and document transaction limitations: team creation updates user before inserting team (DB-01), causing invalid references on failure; workflow status transitions lack atomicity across three writes (DB-02). Repository layer lacks MongoDB session support for proper transactions. Fix DB-01 by reordering operations; document DB-02 limitation for future refactoring.
steps: In backend/api/routes/teams.py create_team() function (lines 64-85), reorder operations: (1) insert team document first (move lines 73-85 before line 70), (2) then update user with valid team_id (line 70). This ensures team exists before user references it.
Add error handling: if user update fails after team insert, log a warning but don't fail the request - team exists and is valid, user just not yet assigned as lead (recoverable state)

In backend/domain/services/workflow_service.py, add comprehensive documentation to transition_task() and transition_story() methods explaining: (a) current implementation does 3 sequential writes without transaction, (b) partial failure can cause inconsistent state, (c) proper fix requires repository layer session support, (d) workaround would use MongoDB replica set transactions with session.start_transaction()
Add TODO comments to both workflow methods: '# TODO: Wrap in transaction when repository layer supports sessions (DB-02)'
Add error logging to workflow transition methods if any write operation fails
Run team tests: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v -k team
Run workflow tests: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/ -v -k workflow
acceptance_criteria: Team creation in backend/api/routes/teams.py inserts team document before updating user, preventing invalid team_id references
Manual test: create team with team lead succeeds with correct order of operations
Workflow service transition methods have detailed documentation explaining transaction limitation and proper fix
TODO comments added to transition_task() and transition_story() referencing DB-02

findings: DB-01: Successfully reordered team creation operations in backend/api/routes/teams.py. Team document is now inserted BEFORE updating user with team_id, preventing invalid references. Added error handling with logging for user update failures (recoverable state). DB-02: Added comprehensive documentation to transition_task() and transition_story() methods in backend/domain/services/workflow_service.py explaining transaction limitation, proper fix requirements (MongoDB replica set + session support), and workaround implementation. Added TODO comments referencing DB-02. Added error logging for all three write operations in both methods. All team tests (14 tests) and workflow tests (23 tests) pass.
